title: Get /guides/dreams-and-sleep back in the index (dropped 2026-11-02, 322 impressions)
body:
URL: /guides/dreams-and-sleep
Cluster: vivid dreams after quitting smoking
Type: technical
Source: GSC 2026-10-06..2026-11-02, URL Inspection 2026-11-05

## Evidence
- URL Inspection 2026-11-05: "Crawled - currently not indexed". Last crawl 2026-09-19, so Google has not seen the BLO-12 refresh (deployed 2026-10-30).
- 322 impressions, 0 clicks, position 8.3 in the 28-day window (prev 28 days: 142). Daily impressions were 10-17 a day until 2026-10-28, then 7, 5, 5, 4, 0, 0 (2026-11-03).
- It was the second-largest guide by impressions. Same pattern as /guides/libido (BLO-26) and /guides/tingling-hands-and-feet (BLO-25).
- The drop isn't caused by the refresh: Google dropped the old version it crawled in September.

## Recommended action
1. Request indexing for https://tryblou.com/guides/dreams-and-sleep in GSC (manual, by the owner).
2. Check the page links in from /guides and at least 3 related guides (insomnia/sleep, fatigue, what-happens-after-1-week). Add links where missing.
3. Don't rewrite the content again: the 10-30 version hasn't been crawled yet.

## Next skill
None (manual GSC step), then seo-performance-audit to confirm.

## Done when
URL Inspection shows "Submitted and indexed" with a crawl date after 2026-10-30, and daily impressions return to 10+ a day.

title: Push /zyn-vs-cigarettes to page 1 (position 11.0, 107 impressions, 0 clicks)
body:
URL: /zyn-vs-cigarettes
Cluster: zyn vs cigarettes
Type: page-2-push
Source: GSC 2026-10-06..2026-11-02

## Evidence
- 107 impressions, 0 clicks, position 11.0 (2026-10-06..11-02). Position was 13.7 on the 10-26 window and 11.4 on the 10-30 window.
- Published 2026-10-15, so it passed the 3-week expected-volatility window today.
- Impressions are spread over many small queries: 'zyn vs cigarettes nicotine content' (2 at 11), 'cigarette vs zyn nicotine content' (1 at 12), '1 zyn vs 1 cigarette' (1 at 1), plus brand queries for other pouches (bat, choice, nicokick). No single head query yet.
- Indexed (URL Inspection 2026-11-05, last crawl 2026-10-15). 2,070 words, 6 FAQs, 3 App Store CTAs, 5 internal links in.
- Nicotine pouches are priority topic 2 in the profile.

## Recommended action
1. Make the first screen answer 'how much nicotine is in a Zyn vs a cigarette' with a one-line number comparison and a small table (mg per pouch vs mg absorbed per cigarette), sourced.
2. Add a short '1 Zyn vs 1 cigarette' section and an FAQ for it.
3. Add links in from /nicotine-patch-side-effects, /quit-smoking-timeline and the /guides hub (currently linked only from the Zyn pages and the pouch calculator).
4. Title is already keyword-first; leave it unless the brief finds a clear gap. Any title change on a page at position 11 carries some risk, so note it in the brief.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Average position under 10 and at least 1 click in a 28-day window within 6 weeks of the update.

title: Separate /zyn-withdrawal from /quit-zyn (4 shared queries, 0 impressions since 2026-10-31)
body:
URL: /zyn-withdrawal
Cluster: zyn withdrawal
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-10-06..2026-11-02, URL Inspection 2026-11-05

## Evidence
- /zyn-withdrawal: 224 impressions, position 59.2 in the window, but daily impressions were 0 from 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-03. Still indexed (last crawl 2026-10-15).
- /quit-zyn: 297 impressions at 63.7, and still getting 16-17 a day.
- Both pages rank for the same 4 queries: 'quitting zyn' (69.2 vs 63.8), 'how long to quit zyn' (60.3 vs 67.2), 'quit zyn cold turkey' (81.3 vs 81.8), 'zyn withdrawal' (64.2 vs 64.8).
- /zyn-withdrawal's own queries: 'zyn withdrawal timeline' 28 at 61.4, 'zyn withdrawal symptoms' 17 at 68.5, 'how long do zyn withdrawals last' 11 at 75.5.

## Recommended action
1. Make /zyn-withdrawal own symptoms and timeline ('zyn withdrawal symptoms', 'zyn withdrawal timeline', 'how long do zyn withdrawals last'). Answer-first with a day-by-day table, sourced.
2. Make /quit-zyn own the how-to (taper, cold turkey, NRT). Trim its withdrawal-timeline section to a short summary that links to /zyn-withdrawal. Coordinate with BLO-19.
3. Don't merge the pages; both intents have demand.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Only one of the two pages shows for each of the 4 shared queries in GSC, and /zyn-withdrawal has daily impressions again.

title: Clear the old /best-quit-smoking-app-for-heavy-smokers URL from Google (redirected, still indexed, 69 impressions)
body:
URL: /best-quit-smoking-app-for-heavy-smokers
Cluster: best quit smoking app
Type: technical
Source: GSC 2026-10-06..2026-11-02, URL Inspection 2026-11-05

## Evidence
- The URL 308-redirects to /best-quit-smoking-apps (checked live 2026-11-05) and isn't in the sitemap. The redirect has been live since 2026-10-13.
- URL Inspection 2026-11-05: still "Submitted and indexed", last crawl 2026-08-29. Google hasn't recrawled it since the redirect went up.
- Impressions are growing on the old URL: 69 at 44.6 (10-26 window: 40 at 52.9). It splits 'the best quit smoking app' (16 at 73.1 vs 37 at 57.3 for /best-quit-smoking-apps) and 'best quit smoking app' (13 at 67.8 vs 34 at 55.6).
- /best-quit-smoking-apps is the closest page to conversion in the comparison cluster.

## Recommended action
1. In GSC, inspect the old URL and request indexing so Google fetches the redirect (manual, by the owner).
2. Check that no page on the site still links to the old URL (grep `src/` for it).
3. If it's still indexed after 3 weeks, temporarily add the old URL to the sitemap so it gets recrawled, then remove it once Google shows it as "Page with redirect".

## Next skill
None (manual GSC step), then seo-performance-audit to confirm.

## Done when
URL Inspection shows "Page with redirect" and GSC no longer reports impressions for the old URL.
